title: Jets LB Jamien Sherwood: Demario Davis's presence benefits the whole team

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jets LB Jamien Sherwood: Demario Davis's presence benefits the whole team
sources.description: Veteran linebacker Demario Davis said that he believes the Jets signed him as a free agent to be a model of what "winning culture looks like" and that process appears to be off to a good start.
